purpose: Select the primary modeling job for an Ontology Vault invocation before source discovery.

types.label: Knowledge vault
types.primary_job: Govern accumulated knowledge and its lifecycle.
types.selection_consequence: Map knowledge roles, evidence, confidence, sessions, premises, and lifecycle gates; do not assume a domain-to-runtime bridge.

types.label: Business or domain
types.primary_job: Model domain meaning and desired behavior independently of implementation.
types.selection_consequence: Model meaning, rules, policies, workflows, and outcomes; implementation artifacts remain out of scope unless separately bridged.

types.label: System or runtime
types.primary_job: Model what a technical system contains and how it behaves at runtime.
types.selection_consequence: Map components, runtime behavior, data, tests, telemetry, and deployment facts; do not treat those facts as domain meaning.

types.label: Business-system bridge
types.primary_job: Evaluate alignment and drift between domain intent and system evidence.
types.selection_consequence: Require evidence from both business and system branches and report realization, coverage, constraints, gaps, and drift.

types.label: Authority and governance
types.primary_job: Model who may decide, what sources may support, and how claims may move.
types.selection_consequence: Map ownership, source posture, reliance, gates, and residue; do not decide or promote authority through the ontology itself.

types.label: Architecture properties
types.primary_job: Describe and evaluate the typed properties an architecture is expected to have.
types.selection_consequence: Model element types, typed properties, relations, profiles, projections, and property findings; do not substitute generic intent-to-implementation traceability.
